title: 3D Design and CAD Automation Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Parametric models, constraints, geometry operations, and export validation. The 3D Design and CAD Automation Database documents designing in 3D, programmatically: parametric models (dimensions as variables, not fixed numbers), constraint systems (this face stays parallel to that one), geometry operations (extrude, revolve, loft, boolean), and export validation (is the STL manifold? will it print?). Parametric design means changing one number rebuilds the part — each record shows the parameter scheme, the constraints, and the validation that the output is actually manufacturable.

title: 3D Design and CAD Automation Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Parametric anatomy: PARAMETERS (named dimensions with ranges and defaults) -> SKETCH (2D profile with geometric constraints: coincident, parallel, perpendicular, tangent; dimensional constraints: lengths, angles) -> FEATURES (operations: extrude, revolve, loft, sweep; booleans: union, subtract, intersect; dress-up: fillet, chamfer) -> VALIDATION. Constraint solving: degrees of freedom reduced by constraints; fully-defined sketches preferred; over-constraint diagnosed. Design tables: parameter sets generating part families. Export: STL (triangles; must be manifold: watertight, no self-intersections); STEP (B-rep, for CAD exchange); 3MF (modern, units + materials). Validation: manifold check, minimum wall thickness vs process, overhang analysis, tolerance stack. Automation: scripts (Python/CadQuery-style) generating variants; version the script with the parameters.

demo.title: Execution: Bayesian knowledge tracing update
demo.code: let pL=0.3;const pT=0.2,pS=0.1,pG=0.25;function update(correct){const pC=pL*(1-pS)+(1-pL)*pG;const pLgiven=correct?(pL*(1-pS)/pC):(pL*pS/(pL*pS+(1-pL)*(1-pG)));pL=pLgiven+(1-pLgiven)*pT;return pL;}const responses=[1,1,0,1,1];const traj=responses.map(update);const mastered=traj[traj.length-1]>=0.95;J({final:+traj[traj.length-1].toFixed(3),mastered});assert(traj.every(v=>v>=0&&v<=1),'bkt-range');assert(traj[traj.length-1]>0.3,'bkt-learn');

demo.title: Verification: concept graph is a DAG
demo.code: const edges=[['arith','algebra'],['algebra','deriv'],['deriv','backprop']];const nodes=[...new Set(edges.flat())];function topo(){const indeg={};nodes.forEach(n=>indeg[n]=0);edges.forEach(([a,b])=>indeg[b]++);const q=nodes.filter(n=>indeg[n]===0);const order=[];while(q.length){const n=q.shift();order.push(n);edges.filter(e=>e[0]===n).forEach(([a,b])=>{if(--indeg[b]===0)q.push(b);});}return order;}const order=topo();J({order,isDAG:order.length===nodes.length});assert(order.length===nodes.length&&order.indexOf('arith')<order.indexOf('backprop'),'dag');
